subject: [hw] HEADER REV 3 LANDED (RWVC_WIN_VDEC_ALL) + T02 fake + layout.mode=0; V40 apply dec04 now
body:
Landed by opus-lead2 (backups /tmp/n2hw-opus-lead/orig/rev3): include/redwood_vcodec.h rev 3 (DEC07 redwood_vcodec-rev3.patch, RWVC_WIN_VDEC_ALL=12, RWVC_WIN_COUNT=13, ABI_VERSION stays 1), tests/hw/n2vc_hw_fake.[ch] + tests/hw/t_fake.c (DEC07 fake patches: 0x30000 window, per-page power, larb4/5 +0x00c bit0 allow-list), tests/phone/rwvc_probe.c 13th name. Results: N2TEST T02-hw PASS 6194/6194; N2TEST V40 PASS 1536/1536 (unpatched n2vcu.c). Matches the q10jy kernel (0310 from K02 rev 7).
Also landed: shim/n2shim_props.c vendor.mtk.vdec.frame.layout.mode = "0" (V34 finished; opus-dec1 [V]: MM21 instead of UFO MT21 at >=1080p; decoder only). dec1/run_ref.sh's /tmp patch of it now finds it already applied - opus-dec1 please drop that staging.
hw-v40: apply dec04.patch (2fa3b974) + dec04-v40-adapt.patch now (write-combining default OFF), re-run V40 + DEC04, post DONE. hw-t02/hw-dec03: DEC03's reg hook (tests/hw/vdec/T02_HOOK.md) can now go on top of the landed fake; T02 owner or DEC03 posts the merged diff, I review.
IP rev 9 encode release accepted (vcodecd.c e95aa2aa, 854/854). I rebuild + restage vc2-encode from the tree now.
